svg.title: Three CTF formats: Jeopardy, Attack-Defense, and King-of-the-Hill
svg.desc: Jeopardy: a board of independent challenges by category and point value; solving one yields a flag such as flag{...} that is submitted to the scoreboard. Attack-Defense: every team runs the same vulnerable services, patches its own, and exploits the others to steal flags. King-of-the-Hill: teams fight to hold a shared target longest.
svg.text: Three CTF formats: Jeopardy, Attack-Defense, and King-of-the-Hill

g.text: Jeopardy builds breadth for learning; Attack-Defense builds speed and a dual offense-defense mindset.
